claims.evidence: Parsed from RAW names 20160817_<run>_<donor>_<Ko|NL|L>. Ko = control (German Kontrolle) is our inference, consistent with the PRIDE description of healthy volunteers vs lesional and non-lesional AD skin. 10 controls (09,13,14,17,20,24,25,28,29,30), 10 AD patients (01-05,21-23,26,27) each with L and NL, plus 3 pool runs (L, NL, Ko). Donor ids are unique across groups; the AD-/control- prefix is ours.
Protocol: dermis peeled from epidermis, epidermis analysed.
Title and description: healthy volunteers and lesional and non-lesional skin of AD patients. Non-lesional skin of patients carries the patient disease.
Compared groups per description; lesional status is a custom characteristic derived from file-name tags L/NL/Ko.
Files 40_NL_pool, 41_L_pool, 42_Ko_pool; protocol says library built from pooled lesional, NL and control samples. Pool composition inferred from names.
No per-sample demographics in the deposit; paper (PMID 36108803, J Invest Dermatol 2022) not open access and full text not read.
Protocol: DIA mode, multiplexed MS2 25 Da windows over 350-1500 m/z.
Protocol text and PRIDE instruments field agree.
Protocol: Lys-C 1:50 and trypsin 1:40 tandem digestion (two repeated columns).
